title: refactor(app-shell): split AiChatPage into ChatPane and helper modules, move-only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS5ABkjZhavN8ufqbqE2sRDe)_

Fixes #37730

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：没有。全页 AI 对话和侧边停靠的对话照常工作，只是代码换了文件放。
- 为什么：`AiChatPage.tsx` 删完 build 后还有 2152 行，后续对话界面改进都要改它，先拆开减少冲突。
- 出问题会怎样：只搬代码不改逻辑，最坏是某个导入断了，类型检查和测试会直接红；回滚这一个合并即可。
- 需要你做的：改动行数 3305（搬家导致增删各一遍）超过 3000 行的人合门槛，按规定需要你点批准或亲手合并；其余照席位流程走。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` goes from 2152 to 652 lines. It keeps `AiChatPage`, `AiChatPageProps`, `EMPTY_INITIAL_MESSAGES`, the `useHomePath()` call and the top bar `<header>`. Everything else moves byte for byte into six modules in the same directory:

| New module | What moved |
|:---|:---|
| `ChatPane.tsx` | `ChatPane`, `ChatPaneProps` |
| `aiChatHydration.ts` | `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages`, `partToolState`, `partApproval`, `partString`, `firstUserMessageText` |
| `aiChatLinks.ts` | `listLinkTarget`, `recordOpenTarget`, `nextSectionOpening` and the module counter `sectionOpenings` |
| `useDeferredFirstSend.ts` | `PendingFirstMessage`, `useDeferredFirstSend`, `isSameFile`, `isSameFirstSend`, `useComposerDraftHandoff`, `ComposerDraftHandoff`, the module `composerDraftHandoffs` WeakMap |
| `aiChatChrome.ts` | `matchAiChatShortcut`, `AiChatShortcut`, `TOGGLE_CHATS_LIST_SHORTCUT`, `NEW_CHAT_SHORTCUT`, `useCollapsibleChatsList`, `CollapsibleChatsList`, `CHATS_COLLAPSED_STORAGE_KEY`, `resolveCollapseToDockTarget` |
| `agentCopy.ts` | `agentEmptyState`, `localizeAgentLabel`, `PLATFORM_AGENT_LABEL_KEYS`, `buildAgentSuggestions`, `genericSuggestions`, `dataChatSuggestions`, `TranslationFn` |

- Every name `AiChatPage.tsx` exported is re-exported from it by name (`export { … } from`, `export type { … } from`; no `export *`), so every import path stands. `ChatDockConversation.tsx` still imports `ChatPane` from `AiChatPage.js`, so the four ChatDock tests that mock that path, and the dock's `React.lazy` boundary, are unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/core.ts` are untouched.
- The two module-level singletons (`sectionOpenings`, `composerDraftHandoffs`) exist once, in their new modules.
- No new module imports `AiChatPage.tsx`. The graph is `AiChatPage → ChatPane → {aiChatLinks, aiChatHydration, agentCopy, useDeferredFirstSend}`, plus `AiChatPage → {aiChatChrome, aiChatHydration, useDeferredFirstSend}`.
- Three helpers that were file-private now cross a module boundary and gained `export` in their new module: `nextSectionOpening`, `firstUserMessageText`, `localizeAgentLabel`. They are not re-exported from `AiChatPage.tsx`, because they were never exported from it.

### What is not a moved line

Apart from moved lines, the diff is only: import lists, the re-export block, a short header comment on each new module, and the three `export` keywords above. Checked by comparing the multiset of removed lines with the multiset of added lines over `console/ai/*.ts(x)`: everything left over on either side is one of those kinds. The import of `ChatbotEnhancedMessage as ChatMessage` keeps its long comment in `aiChatHydration.ts`, the file that produces those messages; `ChatPane.tsx` carries a two-line pointer to it.


### Tests

Only the two read-scope changes the card allows; no assertion changed:

1. `console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.runtimeMessageSeam.test.tsx`, the "#4437 source net": reads `AiChatPage.tsx` and `ChatPane.tsx` joined, since `const runtimeMessages = useMemo(() => toRuntimeMessages(messages), [messages]);` now lives in `ChatPane`.
2. `__tests__/homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`: the AiChatPage site lists the six new modules under its existing `alsoReads`.

## Why

Card #37730 under epic #37690 (split C). The plan was reviewed against the code before the card was filed. Behaviour does not change; this only makes the next AI chat changes conflict less and review smaller.

## Verification

Metadata-protocol: none

In this build the shared lazy chunk that holds `useChatConversation` takes its name from `aiChatHydration` (rolldown's naming pick, not a membership change the budget gate saw).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Size: 3305 changed lines (+1716 / -1589), over the 3000-line threshold, so this lands the Tier H way (an authorized approval, or the maintainer's merge or enqueue), although the change is move-only.
- `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings over the page and the six modules drop from 13 to 11, because the non-component exports left the page file; no new lint warning class appears.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
